Title: Retirement: Log Analytics Batch API to Be Retired on March 31, 2028

Body.Content:
On March 31, 2028, we’ll be retiring the batch API in Azure Monitor Log Analytics. After that date, queries using this API will no longer work. This API version is being retired to comply with Azure’s Versioning Policy. 

 

To avoid service disruptions, move to the standard request API and format for Azure Monitor Log Analytics data access API by March 31, 2028. When adjusting workloads that currently use the batch API, split the queries into single queries and follow the alternative request and response API formats.  

 

Please review any usage of this API via Azure Monitor Query client SDKs. For more information, please refer to our documentation.
